title:

html_source: From Wagner’s opera Die Walkure: “Intense desire, questioning wife, destroys us all.”

 ZOE 

(Tragically.) Hamlet, I am thy father's gimlet! (She takes his hand.) Blue eye'd beauty, I'll read your hand. (She points to his forehead.) No wit, no wrinkles.
